card.title: 185th FOLGORE
card.text: Costs 1 more to deploy if you started the battle.
card.flavorText: The 185th Paratroopers Reconnaissance Target Acquisition Regiment "Folgore" (Italian: 185° Reggimento Paracadutisti Ricognizione Acquisizione Obiettivi "Folgore", abbreviated as 185º RRAO) was an elite Italian airborne unit during WWII. Initially formed with the intention of participating in the planned invasion of Malta, the "Folgore" instead found themselves defending Sicily and mainland Italy from Allied landings. Despite being under-equipped and facing overwhelming odds, the paratroopers demonstrated exceptional bravery and resilience in battles like the Battle of Primosole Bridge, where they held off superior British forces for several days. After the Italian armistice in 1943, some elements of the "Folgore" joined the Allies, fighting alongside them against the Germans.
